response.overview: Harumi's had an overwhelming presence ever since her days as a gravure idol, and she's even been popular in a travel program on daytime TV, where she was selected for an unusual role. We put our nose to the grindstone and set out to shoot Harumi in all her wonderful glory! Her womanly calmness and softness, as well as her high level of feminine power, can be felt straight through the camera. The nude shoot of this refreshing gal made the photographers smile from start to finish - it's a masterpiece that you'll want to keep forever!
response.title: J-Girl Yummy: Harumi Tachibana
